_meta.unit_convention: low, high, and median are the lowest public listing price per vendor for the STANDALONE compound, normalized to the stated unit. Blends are excluded from single-compound bands. Capture these figures while doing VTS scoring passes, when you are already on each vendor's public site.
_meta.how_to_update: Edit a compound's low, high, median, n, and as_of when you refresh vendor scoring. A band only appears on its page once low, high, and median are all real numbers. Leave a compound null to keep its band hidden.
